mapper.sql: article_id, user_id, title, content, status, reported, star_num, collection_num, comment_num, share_num, page_view, time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT a.article_id, a.user_id, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.reported, a.star_num, a.collection_num, a.comment_num, a.share_num, a.page_view, a.time, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.username, u.nickname, u.portrait FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId}
